definitions.primary_duplicate_resolution: median record-level value at an event-analyte key
definitions.primary_pair_key: PWS ID + sampling point ID + sample date + nonmissing sample time
definitions.primary_record_scope: 2023-2025; analyte 2456 or 2950; RT; DS; UG/L; valid quantified or censored value

limitations: The California archive validates HAA5/TTHM co-occurrence only; it contains no HAA9 total.
Public-archive separation does not establish statistical independence from every national data product.
Concentration-level reference comparisons are not regulatory compliance determinations.
The observational analysis does not support causal claims.
